info.name: Tradeshift External Dx Category Assignments Find API

params.name: companyid
params.description: Company (tenant) UUID used to filter assignments.

params.name: assigneeids
params.description: List of  UUIDs of assignees, used to filter assignments.

params.name: with_tags
params.description: List of strings representing tags to be used to filter assignments.

params.name: without_tags
params.description: List of strings representing tags to be used to exclude assignments.

params.name: status
params.description: List of statuses to be used to filter assignment (e.g. OPEN, CLOSED, WAITING_FOR_ASSIGNEES)

params.name: type
params.description: String representing a type used to filter assignments.

params.name: type_category
params.description: String representing a type category(a collection of assignment types)

params.name: created_from
params.description: Datetime used to get assignments created after this date.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Datetime used to get assignments created before this date.

params.name: modified_from
params.description: Datetime used to get assignments modified after this date.

params.name: modified_to
params.description: Datetime used to get assignments modified before this date.

params.name: subjectid
params.description: Represents a free form identifier ( usually a document UUID ) of the subject the assignment is referring to and can be used to search assignments by.

params.name: externalid
params.description: Free form string representing a custom client identifier which can be used later to search assignments by. Assignments service makes no uniqueness validation on this identifier.

params.name: page
params.description: Number representing the page to be return from the paginated result-set.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of assignments displayed per page.

items.docs: Get a paginated list of assignments filtered by the following query parameters. The search will be performed on assignments from the current branch and child branches.

params.name: id
params.description: An UUID representing the assignment id.

items.docs:
Get the assignment with the given id.
The assignment will be visible if the company is the current branch or one of the child branches.
